key.name: kept
key.description: The Dock items kept in the dock when the program has no window, in the order they are shown in. Each is a desktop entry's id, such as "firefox.desktop", or the path of a desktop entry that has no id.

key.name: kept-folders
key.description: The folders kept in the dock after the separator, in the order they are shown in. Each is a folder's URI, such as "file:///home/user/Documents".
